title: Taiwanese American Association of Pharmaceutics 台美藥劑協會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Association of Pharmaceutics (TAAP) is a professional organization with members located primarily in the United States and Taiwan. Its membership consists largely of individuals with advanced degrees in life science-related fields, including academic researchers, senior scientists, and professionals in managerial positions. Members work across various areas of biopharmaceutical discovery and development. The organization serves as a network bridging Taiwanese American pharmaceutical and biotech professionals across both countries.
